2608.03796.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
2608.03796.paper_summary: Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD). This recovery step largely decides the final quality, yet it is expensive. We present a practitioner's study of how to make distillation training efficient, organised around two systems contributions. First, we show that offline KD (caching the teacher's top-$K$ logits once and training the student against the cache) matches online distillation at near-identical training loss while removing the teacher from memory, running about 29\% faster per iteration, and reaching up to 41\% higher throughput on a single H200 GPU. Second, we introduce a \emph{fused, chunked KL loss} that never materialises the full vocabulary-sized logit tensor, making peak memory linear in the sequence length. This removes the memory spike that otherwise caps context length and lets us train at four times the context (32{,}768 tokens) on a single GPU. A separate output-head-only toy benchmark isolates the loss kernel and confirms its memory and iteration-rate scaling from 4K to 256K tokens. Together these make large-scale healing and hundreds of ablations affordable. We also report supporting ablations on loss design and sequence packing. We release our chunked-loss implementation: https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss.
2608.03796.paper_summary_zh: 小型語言模型通常是在嚴格的延遲、成本和本地部署限制下唯一的選擇，但它們很少是從零開始訓練的：壓縮模型通常是通過知識蒸餾（KD）恢復的。這一步恢復在很大程度上決定了最終質量，但它是昂貴的。我們提出了一項實踐者研究，探討如何使蒸餾訓練高效，圍繞兩個系統貢獻進行組織。首先，我們展示了離線KD（一次緩存教師的前$K$個logits並對學生進行練習）在接近相同的訓練損失下與在線蒸餾相匹配，同時將教師從記憶中移除，每次迭代速度提高約29\%，並在單個H200 GPU上達到高達41\%的吞吐量。其次，我們引入了一種\emph{融合的、分塊的KL損失}，該損失從不生成完整詞彙大小的logit張量，使峰值內存隨序列長度線性增長。這消除了通常限制上下文長度的內存峰值，並使我們能夠在單個GPU上以四倍的上下文（32{,}768個標記）進行訓練。一個單獨的僅輸出頭的玩具基準測試隔離了損失內核，並確認其內存和迭代速率從4K擴展到256K標記的可擴展性。這些共同使大規模的修復和數百次的消融變得可負擔。我們還報告了對損失設計和序列打包的支持性消融。我們發布了我們的分塊損失實現：https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss。
